changelog: FIX (Fire Stick crash storm — ROOT CAUSE): For two years, every Amazon-branded device was force-pushed to Pro mode regardless of actual hardware capability — Skyworth TVs (lower-spec but classified properly) ran Lite mode smoothly while Fire Sticks crashed within 10-15 sec on the home screen. Removed Amazon from the blanket premium-brand list and added per-app heap class (≥192 MB) as a real capability gate. Result: AFTSS / AFTKM / AFTSSS / AFTKRT (all have ≤128 MB heap) now run Lite mode by default — same UI Skyworth users already run with zero crashes. Fire TV Cube and other genuinely-powerful Amazon devices keep Pro automatically.

MIGRATION: Existing Fire Stick users currently on Pro will be silently auto-flipped to Lite on their first v1.44.122 launch (one-shot, never re-runs). A one-time toast surfaces so they know why their UI changed and how to opt back to Pro from Settings → App Mode. Manual Pro selection is respected forever after that.

REVERT: v1.44.121's memoryClass-128 low-RAM bump is superseded — Lite mode skips the entire heavy Compose tree (Ken Burns animator, AnimatedContent crossfade, hero AsyncImage cascade) rather than just trimming bitmap allocation, which was treating the symptom not the cause.
DIAGNOSTIC (v521): NEW BootPhaseTracker for ALL API levels (closes the Android 9 / AFTSS blind spot).
DIAGNOSTIC (v521): ExitInfoCollector hardening — payloads persist to disk before upload, watermark advances per-exit.
DIAGNOSTIC (v520): Captures post-mortem exit reasons via ApplicationExitInfo.
FIX (v519): Memory-trimmed Pro for the original 1 GB Fire Sticks (RGB_565 posters, tighter Coil cache).
FIX (v518): Crash reports tagged with Xtream username.
FIX (v517): Navigation Compose bump for BACK-button crash.
FIX (v516): 4 Movie/Series crashes on weak Fire Sticks.
FIX (v515): 'Switch to Lite Mode' takes effect instantly.
FIX (v514): Permanent ANR fix via Moshi codegen.
NEW: 72-hour free trial for first-time Canada users.
